steps.say: Prices in rupiah use a point to group the thousands. Rp12.500 is twelve thousand five hundred rupiah.
These notes and coins make Rp12.500.

figure.alt: One Rp10.000 note, one Rp2.000 note and one Rp500 coin.

steps.say: When the items cost the same, multiply to find the total.
To find change, take the total away from the money paid.

check.prompt: Arif buys 4 notebooks at Rp6.000 each. How much does Arif pay?
hints: Each notebook costs the same, so multiply.

check.prompt: Bella buys a book for Rp35.500 and pays with Rp50.000. How much change does Bella get?
hints: Change is the money paid take away the price.
Count up from Rp35.500 to Rp36.000 first.
Then count up from Rp36.000 to Rp50.000.
